author_prompt:
Author 8 DIFFERENT natural ecommerce customer-service dialogue families in en.
Batch 5; ensure at least four current turns classified as human_service across this batch.
Each family has its OWN coherent history of 2, 4 or 6 short alternating user/assistant
messages, followed by 3 ALTERNATIVE current user turns, not three sequential turns.
Those alternatives differ in effective intent: retain vs replace, withdraw vs
continue, single goal vs concurrent goal, or resolved vs unresolved reference.
Include natural short answers where history matters. Vary old completed tasks,
hesitation, self-correction, indirect wording, topics and dialogue acts. General
and human-service requests must also occur as NEW goals, not only stale history.
Do not follow a repeated sentence template or substitute product nouns to create
new families. Avoid stereotyped 'information only, do not submit' repetition.
Invent broad everyday ecommerce situations; no copied benchmark or private data.
History plus current turn should fit 150 English words or 180 Chinese characters;
keep it compact but meaningful. No future replies or final conversation summaries.
Supply the correct label for each alternative according to the rubric.

families.scenario: Customer asks about a smartwatch they received as a gift but the band is too small.

messages.content: Hi, I got the FitPulse S2 watch as a birthday gift but the strap is really tight on my wrist.
I'm sorry to hear that! The S2 ships with a standard 150mm band. We do sell an XL strap separately for $12.99.
Oh okay. Would the XL fit the S2 model or only the newer ones?
The XL strap is compatible with the S2, S3, and S4 models. It's listed under accessories on our site.
Great, I'll check that out. Thanks for the help.

variants.text: Actually, before I buy the strap — can you tell me if the S2 has a replaceable battery or is it sealed?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: I'd rather just return the whole watch and pick a different model instead. How do I start a return?
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: You know what, forget the strap. I want to speak to a real person about whether this gift can be exchanged for store credit.
variants.label: human_service

families.scenario: Customer's package shows delivered but they never received it.

messages.content: My order #48291 says delivered yesterday but I never got it. The photo shows a porch but I don't have a porch.
That's concerning. Let me check the delivery details for order #48291.
Okay, please do. I've been waiting on this for two weeks already.
I see the carrier marked it as left at the front door. I can file a claim with them on your behalf.

variants.text: Yes, please file the claim. Also, while you're at it, is the matching phone case I ordered still in stock for a replacement?
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Actually, I just found the package with my neighbor. Sorry for the trouble — you can close this out.
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: I've called twice already and nobody helped. Put me through to a supervisor or file a formal complaint right now.
variants.label: human_service

families.scenario: Customer wants to change the shipping address on an order placed minutes ago.

messages.content: I just placed order #77315 and realized I'm moving next week. Can I change the delivery address?
Let me check if order #77315 has been picked up by the warehouse yet.
It's only been like five minutes, so hopefully not.
Good news — it hasn't shipped yet. I can update the address if you give me the new one.

variants.text: The new address is 42 Maple Lane, Apt 3B. Oh wait — actually it's 42 Maple Avenue, not Lane. Sorry, I keep mixing that up.
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Hold on, I think I'd rather just cancel this order entirely and reorder once I'm settled. Can you cancel it?
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Before I give you the address — does changing it affect the delivery estimate shown at checkout?
variants.label: order_logistics

families.scenario: Customer received a damaged blender and wants a replacement.

messages.content: My blender arrived with a cracked jar. I opened it this morning and saw the damage right away.
I'm sorry about that. Since it arrived damaged, we can send a replacement at no cost. Would you like that?
Yes, a replacement would be great. Do I need to send the damaged one back?
No need to return it. I'll process a replacement jar and it should arrive in 3-5 business days.

variants.text: Perfect, thank you. Also, I noticed the receipt shows I was charged twice for this order — can you look into that?
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Actually, on second thought, just refund me instead. I don't trust this model anymore after seeing how fragile it is.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: I appreciate the offer but I'm frustrated with how long the original took to arrive. I want to file a complaint about the shipping carrier.
variants.label: human_service

families.scenario: Customer forgot their password and cannot log in.

messages.content: I can't log into my account. It says my password is wrong but I'm sure it's the one I always use.
No problem — I can help you reset it. I'll send a reset link to the email on file.
Okay, but I'm not getting the email. It might be going to spam or maybe I used a different email.
Let me verify which email is associated with your account. Can you confirm your full name and phone number?

variants.text: My name is Dana Whitfield and my phone is 555-0142. Wait, I think I used my work email — try dana@brightco.com.
variants.label: account_security

variants.text: Honestly, I'm tired of this. Is there a way to talk to someone from your security team directly?
variants.label: human_service

variants.text: Actually, never mind. I remembered my password — it was caps lock. Sorry to bother you!
variants.label: account_security

families.scenario: Customer asks about warranty coverage on a laptop that won't turn on.

messages.content: My NovaBook 14 won't power on at all. I bought it in March last year, so it's about 14 months old.
The NovaBook 14 comes with a 12-month standard warranty, so it may have just expired. Let me check your purchase record.
Hmm, that's disappointing. I thought it was longer.
I see you purchased it on March 3rd last year. Unfortunately, the standard warranty ended last month. However, I can offer a paid repair estimate.

variants.text: Okay, what would the repair cost roughly? And is there any way to extend coverage for future issues?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: That's not acceptable. I want to escalate this to a manager — a laptop dying after 14 months shouldn't be normal.
variants.label: human_service

variants.text: Wait, I actually bought an extended warranty add-on at checkout. Can you double-check that?
variants.label: billing_refund

families.scenario: Customer wants to know if a coffee maker they're eyeing is on sale this week.

messages.content: Hey, is the BrewMaster 500 on sale right now? I saw an ad but the price on the site looks different.
The BrewMaster 500 is currently at its regular price of $89.99. The ad you saw may have been for last week's promotion.
Oh, that's a bummer. Do you know when the next sale might happen?
I don't have exact dates, but we typically run promotions around major holidays. You could sign up for our newsletter to get notified.

variants.text: Got it, thanks for the info. Have a nice day!
variants.label: general

variants.text: Alright, I'll wait then. By the way, does the BrewMaster 500 come with a reusable filter or only paper ones?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: I'd like to speak with someone in pricing about whether they can match the price I saw in the ad.
variants.label: human_service

families.scenario: Customer reports unauthorized charges on their account.

messages.content: I see two charges on my card from your store that I definitely didn't make. One is from yesterday and one from today.
That's serious — let me pull up your recent transactions right away to investigate.
Please do. I've already locked my card with my bank, but I need to know what happened here.
I can see both charges were made through your saved payment method on this account. I'm flagging this for our fraud team.

variants.text: Thank you. While that's being looked into, can you also tell me if my recent order #90211 has shipped yet?
variants.label: account_security

variants.text: This is the second time something like this has happened. I want to file a formal complaint and talk to your fraud department directly.
variants.label: human_service

variants.text: Actually, wait — I just remembered I let my sister borrow my card to buy something. Let me check with her before you escalate anything.
variants.label: account_security
